description: Per-system-role ratchet of reachable unresolved ("any role") role-assumption sites, checked by the role-assumption-reachability gate (scripts/analyze_role_assumptions.ts). A role fails when its count rises above this number; lower it when sites are resolved. Regenerate with `node --import ./scripts/ts-loader.mjs scripts/analyze_role_assumptions.ts --print-unresolved-baseline > knowledge/product/governance/role-assumption-unresolved-baseline.json`.
